// cd and pwd.
$ pwd
/root
$ cd /usr/bin && pwd
/usr/bin
$ cd .. && pwd
/usr
$ cd - 
/usr/bin
$ cd /nope
-bash: cd: /nope: No such file or directory
[exit 1]
$ cd /etc/passwd
-bash: cd: /etc/passwd: Not a directory
[exit 1]
$ cd /tmp /etc
-bash: cd: too many arguments
[exit 1]
$ cd && pwd
/root

// echo and printf.
$ echo -n no newline
no newline
[no newline]
$ echo -e 'tab\there\nnewline'
tab	here
newline
$ echo -e 'stop\c here'
stop
[no newline]
$ printf '%s=%d\n' a 1 b 2
a=1
b=2
$ printf '%5s|%-5s|%03d|%x\n' ab cd 7 255
   ab|cd   |007|ff
$ printf 'no args\n'
no args

// Variables, aliases and types.
$ export FOO=bar; env | grep FOO
FOO=bar
$ export 1BAD=x
-bash: export: `1BAD=x': not a valid identifier
[exit 1]
$ alias hi='echo hello'; hi there
hello there
$ alias hi
alias hi='echo hello'
$ unalias hi; hi
hi: command not found
[exit 127]
$ type cd ls ll nosuch
cd is a shell builtin
ls is aliased to `ls --color=auto'
ll is aliased to `ls -alF'
-bash: type: nosuch: not found
[exit 1]
$ command -v ls cd
/usr/bin/ls
cd
$ which ls nosuch
/usr/bin/ls
[exit 1]
$ read -p "Name: " NAME
< Ada
Name: Ada
$ echo "hello $NAME"
hello Ada
$ echo 'a b c' | (read X Y; echo "$Y/$X")
b c/a

// test and [.
$ test -d /etc && echo dir; [ -f /etc/passwd ] && echo file; [ -e /nope ] || echo missing
dir
file
missing
$ [ 3 -gt 5 ] || echo small; [ abc = abc ] && echo equal; [ -z "" ] && echo empty
small
equal
empty
$ [ 1 -lt 2
-bash: [: missing `]'
[exit 2]
$ [ -x /usr/bin/ls ] && echo exec; [ -w /etc/passwd ] && echo writable
exec
writable

// Scripts, source and eval.
$ echo 'echo sourced $1' > /tmp/s.sh; . /tmp/s.sh arg; source /tmp/s.sh
sourced arg
sourced
$ eval 'echo $((1+1))'
2
$ eval "X=7"; echo $X
7
$ history
$ ulimit -n
1024
$ umask
0022
